title: Identification of Nitrogen Fixation Genes in Lactococcus Isolated from Maize Using Population Genomics and Machine Learning.
summary: Population-genomic ML analysis of Lactococcus isolates from Sierra Mixe maize links candidate genetic features to measured nitrogen-fixation phenotypes; the source reports genotype associations, not a causal gene knockout validation. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
